property_summary: For any caller who is the owner and any recipient address, if the contract holds a positive balance then after owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) the contract balance becomes zero (i.e., the entire balance is sent out); the mutant that forces transfer to owner can violate that observable (address(c).balance == 0) when the recipient != owner because funds go to owner instead of the chosen recipient only when recipient != owner the contract still ends with zero balance — to distinguish, we instead observe that the chosen recipient's balance increases by the contract balance for the reference but not for the mutant, so the rule: when owner calls withdrawAll(recipient) and recipient != owner and contract has positive balance, then recipient's balance increases by the contract balance; the mutant breaks this for some fuzzed recipient.
change_summary: Change withdrawal recipient to always be the owner instead of the provided _recipient argument.
